mechanism.who_is_forced_or_underreacts: The FORCED participant is the plan seller: a sale executed under a DECLARED 10b5-1 plan is pre-committed, scheduled, price-insensitive - liquidity and diversification supply that cannot be withheld and carries minimal fresh adverse information. The discretionary (non-plan) seller is the informed marginal: they chose to sell NOW, out of a blackout-legal window, without a plan - their sale carries adverse selection. The LATE/wrong participant is the attention-limited headline reader who prices ALL insider sales with one coarse discount because parsing the new post-2023 aff10b5One field is not standard practice (truthy on only 6,215 of 80,170 tagged post-2023 docs): mostly-planned sell-flow names are OVER-discounted and mostly-discretionary sell-flow names UNDER-discounted at the acceptance print.
mechanism.why_the_effect_exists: The routine-vs-opportunistic split is one of the strongest documented decompositions of insider flow (Cohen-Malloy-Pomorski 2012: routine trades carry little information, opportunistic trades a great deal). CMP's classification is INFERRED from trading-pattern regularity - and the INFERRED form died in this program as SFV13-A4-P2 (D2 novelty 0.2402 vs vol_level, INELIGIBLE_NOVELTY). The amended post-2023 Form-4 schema now carries the class membership as a FILER-DECLARED document-level field - a materially different information source (self-reported intent, not statistical inference over realized patterns). If the market prices the two sell classes alike (limited attention to the flag), the COMPOSITION of sell flow predicts post-filing drift: issuers whose sell flow is mostly DECLARED-plan recover relative to issuers whose sell flow is mostly discretionary.
mechanism.observable: planshare(e,t) = value of flagged disposition (D-coded, truthy-declared doc) non-derivative rows / value of ALL disposition (D-coded) non-derivative rows of entity e with acceptance in the trailing 63 trading days ending at decision close t, in [0,1] by construction; ratio of two quantities of the SAME stream - no price level, no volume, no ranking of flow direction.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: (i) the market already differentiates declared from discretionary sales (contrast drift <= 0 after band costs); (ii) DECLARED-plan sales are as informed as discretionary ones (plan ADOPTION timing is itself strategic - the Jagolinzer dark reading: plans set up ahead of anticipated declines) - the contrast collapses toward zero; (iii) the sham-insider matched no-flag cohort reproduces the anchor same-sign >= 0.5x (flag linkage fiction); (iv) the filing-arrival clock shadow reproduces the anchor (it was arrival/attention mass); (v) D2 measures pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs ANY of the 15 veto entries - vol_level is the NAMED most-plausible death (the INFERRED twin died at 0.2402, and plan-share may load on volatility regime through plan-adoption propensities); (vi) carried stage-A gates fail; (vii) P2 finds the sell-flow cohort with non-degenerate denominators below the cycle's frozen decision floor - BLOCKED_DATA honestly.
mechanism.which_control_kills_the_convenient_expla: 'Any insider-sale book on these names works' is killed by the sham-insider control (matched no-flag filer cohort with flag-permutation support: truthy flags permuted within (acceptance-session, sector) cells preserving the flag-count marginal, destroying the flag-to-issuer linkage; full machinery recomputed - if a random flag reassignment carries the same contrast, the flag content is fiction). 'It is just filings/attention at these names' is killed by the filing-arrival clock shadow (plain acceptance-mass book, same dates, both orientations). 'It is volatility-regime sorting' is killed at D2 by the declared vol_level ancestry check on the frozen representation, fail-closed.

It is not the net-direction family re-clocked (SFV13-A4-P1, 0.232 vs vol_level): no cross-sectional ranking of overall flow direction anywhere - the anchor ranks the COMPOSITION of sell flow, defined only where sell flow exists, and buy-side rows never enter the exposure. It is not a dividend-transition or corp-action re-clock: no EODHD div/split conditioning; EODHD series are the pricing leg only. The named most-plausible death is vol_level (the inferred twin died exactly there, and declared plan-share may still load on volatility regime through plan-adoption propensities): ancestry is MEASURED at D2 on the frozen representation, fail-closed, and this lane accepts the kill in advance.

falsification_rule: FROZEN before any PnL: (1) SHAM: if the flag-permutation matched no-flag sham book reproduces the anchor's identifying metric (overall risk-matched SPY-excess alpha) with the SAME SIGN at >= 0.5x magnitude, the family is DEAD. (2) ARRIVAL: if the filing-arrival clock-shadow book reproduces the anchor same-sign >= 0.5x in either pre-declared orientation, the family is DEAD. (3) ANCESTRY: pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs ANY of the 15 veto entries at D2 => BLOCKED_NOVELTY pre-score, fail-closed on unmeasured entries. (4) SELF-SUBSUMPTION: pooled anchor-vs-shadow Spearman rho >= 0.98 => DESIGN_FAILURE pre-score (the V12 0.9923 lesson). (5) NEIGHBOUR opposite sign on the identifying metric => withdraw the declared-contrast reading (support failure). (6) NO RESCUE: no threshold, universe, cost, gate, window or fold change after any PnL is visible; REJECT and BLOCKED are successful outcomes of this negative-first cycle.
expected_failure_interpretation: If the anchor is <= 0 after base costs with all controls quiet: the declared-plan composition of sell flow is efficiently priced (or carries no composition information) - a clean scientific rejection. If D2 fires on vol_level at ~0.24-like margins: the DECLARED version of the intent axis dies as its INFERRED twin did - the insider-intent axis is measured-closed on this substrate in both forms, a durable negative. If the strategic-adoption reading is right (Jagolinzer dark side) the contrast may come out NEGATIVE (planned sell flow MORE adverse than discretionary): that is the neighbour/support-signature question, never a reason to flip the book - a negative anchor with quiet controls is recorded as the measured answer. If the arrival shadow fires: the flag carries no incremental content beyond filing mass. If the sham fires: the plan-share spread is a distributional artifact (falsification-by-control cluster). If P2 finds the ranked population below floor: BLOCKED_DATA, honestly, before any selection.
distinctness_vs_sibling: SFNG1-A4-P2 (this proposal) uses the flag's INCREMENTAL content (plan-vs-nonplan CONTRAST within the same entity's sell flow; universe = sell-flow cohort superset; exposure = value-form plan-share ratio; neighbour = identity-count form). SFNG1-A4-P1 uses the flagged flow's OWN persistence/cadence structure (universe = flagged cohort; exposure = session-count cadence; neighbour = value-density days-of-supply). Different information source (flag's marginal content vs flagged flow's internal structure) and different book construction (composition rank vs persistence rank) - not a parameter difference.
